releases.title: PromQL evaluation choice and ClickHouse 26.10
releases.summary: You can now choose how a PromQL source on ClickHouse is evaluated — through the Prometheus HTTP API or the `prometheusQuery` table functions — instead of leaving HyperDX to probe the server on every query.

highlights.text: system.metric_log moves to the bucketed schema
New TimeSeries tables default to schema version 8
clickstack_service_health no longer returns a verdict
Choose how a PromQL source is evaluated
Split the service map by extra dimensions

releases.title: Time zone picker and optional webhook emoji
releases.summary: You can now pick a time zone straight from the time picker on the search and dashboard pages, overriding the one set in your User Preferences, and teams can create their own API keys — with a description and an expiry — that keep working after the person who created them leaves.

releases.title: Multipath TCP disabled in the collector image
releases.summary: The collector image now sets `GODEBUG=multipathtcp=0` at startup, so it no longer opens Multipath TCP listeners — Go 1.24 and later turn them on by default — which mitigates CVE-2026-98432 with no change needed on your side.

releases.title: Alert tags in webhooks and OTel session replay
releases.summary: Alerts now carry their tags into webhook notifications: Generic and incident.io webhook bodies can read `{{tags}}` as a comma-separated list or iterate them with `{{#each tags}}`, so one shared webhook can route alerts to the team that owns them.

releases.title: Ad hoc dashboard filters and docked alert editing
releases.summary: Dashboards gain ad hoc filters: add filters to a dashboard on the fly, have the conditions broadcast to every tile, and click a cell in a search or table tile to filter by that value without opening an editor.
